description.value: Steamship Grill & Bar occupies the historic 1924 Heritage Steamship Terminal building on Victoria's inner harbour, designed by Francis Rattenbury in the Beaux-Arts style and now a landmark directly across from the BC Legislature. The restaurant specializes in fresh local seafood — halibut, salmon, oysters, mussels — paired with BC wines and Victoria craft beers, served on a heated and covered harborfront patio voted one of Canada's Top 100. It can accommodate groups from 10 to 200, making it a practical stop for cycling tour groups passing through downtown Victoria.
